units.source_text: 我是自由之身，也就是说，纵然我想要中途退学，

en.t: I was free, in other words, even if I wanted to leave school halfway through,

units.source_text: 或是去哪里，过怎样的生活，以至同什么人结婚，等等，

en.t: or go somewhere, live whatever kind of life I chose, or even marry whomever I wished, and so on,
I did not need to consult anyone about it.

units.source_text: 我曾经不止一次下过决心，干脆跟夫人说，请她把小姐许配给我。

en.t: More than once, I had made up my mind to speak frankly to the lady and ask her to give her daughter to me in marriage.

units.source_text: 但是，每次我都犹豫不决，最终也没有说出口。

en.t: But each time I hesitated, and in the end I never brought myself to say it.
It was not that I was afraid of being refused.

units.source_text: 倘若被夫人拒绝，我的命运不知会发生怎样的变化，

en.t: If the lady refused me, I did not know how my fate might change,

units.source_text: 但是，因此我就有机会站在与以前完全不同的角度，重新展望世界，

en.t: but because of that, I would have the chance to stand in a completely different position from before and look out over the world anew,

units.source_text: 所以说，要拿出这点勇气，也不是办不到。

en.t: so it was not impossible for me to summon that much courage.

units.source_text: 然而，我最厌恶的是被人诱导，最痛恨的是落入别人的圈套。

en.t: However, what I hated most was being led on, and what I detested most was falling into someone else's trap.

units.source_text: 叔叔的欺骗使我下定了决心，今后无论发生什么事，绝对不能让人蒙骗自己。

en.t: Having been deceived by my uncle, I had resolved that whatever happened from then on, I would never let anyone deceive me again.
